_comment: Each entry below makes one element. Change the words, run  python make_elements.py  and the PNGs appear in the out folder. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. All the options are in START HERE.html.

elements._comment: A panel with a lead-in line and bullet points, in the look of the game's code editor.
elements.name: example_bullets
elements.title: OBJECTIVES
elements.label: CHAPTER 1

blocks.text: A short lead-in sentence goes here. Panels wrap text for you.

bullets: Second point, which can be longer and will wrap onto a second line by itself

elements._comment: Code with one line marked as the error, then the output, like the AVP.
elements.name: example_code
elements.title: CODE EDITOR
elements.label: LEVEL 1

elements._comment: One big figure with a caption, for a results slide. Put your real number in.

elements.title: RESULT
elements.label: CHAPTER 4

elements.name: example_odin_says
elements.speaker: Odin
elements.text: Type what ODIN says here. Long lines wrap by themselves.

elements._comment: A dialogue box with a picture inside. portrait can be odin, a team member (jerson, johan, russell, ian), doc_jello, doc_shane, enemy25, or a file.

elements.speaker: Russell
